question_cn: 2026 世界杯 K 组小组赛（2026-06-27）：哥伦比亚 vs 葡萄牙，90 分钟三路赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group K (2026-06-27): Colombia vs Portugal, three-way result after 90 minutes?
one_liner_cn: 两队 Elo 仅差 7 分、实力几乎完全对等，这场 K 组收官战大概率是争头名之战，三路概率高度接近，葡萄牙仅以毫厘领先。
one_liner_en: Only 7 Elo points separate the sides; this likely Group K top-spot decider is a near coin-flip across all three outcomes, with Portugal ahead by a hair.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 几乎持平：哥伦比亚 1982（第 7）vs 葡萄牙 1989（第 6），中立场 Davidson 模型给出 36.3/25.9/37.8 的基准三路概率。
key_reasons.en: Near-identical Elo: Colombia 1982 (7th) vs Portugal 1989 (6th); the neutral-venue Davidson model yields a 36.3/25.9/37.8 baseline.

key_reasons.cn: 末轮大概率为争头名之战，双方或均已出线，轮换与求稳情形小幅抬升平局概率。
key_reasons.en: Likely a final-matchday top-spot decider with both sides possibly already qualified, nudging draw likelihood up via rotation and risk aversion.

key_reasons.cn: 状态信号略偏哥伦比亚：哥伦比亚 2-0 完胜约旦收官，葡萄牙两场热身均一球小胜且 C罗连续 5 场未进球。
key_reasons.en: Form signal slightly favors Colombia: a clean 2-0 over Jordan versus two narrow one-goal Portugal wins and Ronaldo five internationals without scoring.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net ratings, plus a bounded sourced adjustment (~2pp total, cap 8pp), renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.
